author: 5kO0
content: Observation (Phase 3a baseline): `diff -r <fresh-regen> crates/proto-blue-api/src/generated` produces 13839 lines of pre-existing drift. The committed generated/ tree is fmt-normalized (per commit fd91a50 'clippy + fmt cleanup'), while the codegen emits unformatted text. The correct regen-drift invariant is: after `rustfmt --edition 2024` on the regen output, diff against committed must be 0 lines. Verified at baseline: 0. I will use this fmt-then-diff form as the regen-drift gate.
